info.title: JenLow Network API
info.description: Cloudflare Worker + D1. /v1/auth/* keeps the beta auth contract ({"error":"code"}); /api/* uses the error envelope {"error":{code,message,requestId,details?}}. Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. Lists use opaque keyset cursors.

bearer.bearerFormat: JWT (HS256, iss jenlow-network-api, aud jenlow-network, 15 min)
